meta.title: Novel Fish
meta.description: Append local novel text below a separator after real content when actively expanding selected native regions.

chat.noBook: Select a book under Plugins → Novel Fish first.
chat.switchHint: Collapse and actively expand this region to read from the current progress.
chat.readError: The passage could not be loaded; progress did not change.
chat.retry: Collapse and actively expand this region to retry.

settings.title: Novel Fish
settings.description: Import a book and select one or more native region types. Active expansion keeps real content and appends plain novel text below a separator; nothing is sent to the model.
settings.typeHint: A different region’s first active expansion continues reading. Select none to stop reading.
settings.continueOnReopenHint: When on, collapsing and actively reopening the same region reads the next passage; when off, reopening only shows the passage already there.
settings.sampleLicense: Full offline licenses and attribution notices (TXT)
settings.samplePgNotice: The following Project Gutenberg statement applies only to the English collection The Million Pound Bank Note and Other New Stories, not to the other bundled books:
settings.emptyLibrary: Import an EPUB, TXT, or MD file to begin.
settings.nativeControls: Icons and disclosure interactions follow DSH.
settings.nativeTitle: Follow the native DSH region title
settings.noExtra: Follow the native DSH region summary
settings.presetHint: Choose presets without typing; an input appears only when Custom is selected.
settings.jumpDescription: {title} has {total} passages. Choose the next passage to read; enter {end} to mark it finished. Confirming clears displayed novel passages, not the original AI content.
settings.invalidPosition: Enter a whole passage number within the allowed range
settings.progressUpdated: Progress updated; the next active expansion starts at the new position
settings.exportDone: Backup downloaded. It contains book text, progress and settings; keep it safe.
settings.restoreDescription: The backup contains {count} books. Merge without deleting existing books; identical books keep their current progress. Restore the backup selection and reading settings, and clear this page’s displayed novel passages.
settings.removeConfirm: Delete {title} and its local reading progress?
